summary: At {place}, a worker has to reconstruct a day of park visits at a desktop after the shift’s fieldwork.
realLife: Seattle’s maintenance crews entered time at a desktop after their rounds using separate codes for location, route and task.
gates: Time-entry rules and a shift containing multiple site visits.
weights: More stops make delayed entries harder to reconstruct.
inGame: needs: shift entry time, route codes and any contemporaneous stop list.

turns.what: The supervisor checks a disputed entry against it.
turns.pulledBy: The worker saved a paper list of stops.
turns.writesBack: Correct the location on the timecard.

turns.what: The analyst can count hours but cannot identify the disputed stop.
